overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals addressed variance and special permit requests for residential conversions, commercial signage, and building renovations. The board approved all active petitions and continued two cases to ensure consistent voting membership.

items.title: 1-3 Vassar Street and 12-14 Wellesley Street
items.summary: Continued both matters to September 24 at the request of the petitioner's attorney. The delay ensures that the voting members have time to review recordings of previous hearings to maintain consistency in the deliberative process.

items.title: 73 Surrey Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for lot area to allow the conversion of a single-family dwelling into a two-family home. The approval was conditioned on the use of permeable pavers for the new parking area to manage site drainage.

items.title: 501 High Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for a projecting sign for Everett Bank that exceeds current dimensional limits but matches a previous sign at the site. The board specified that the sign must not be internally illuminated.

items.title: 26 Second Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to extend an existing dormer that encroaches on a side-yard setback to accommodate a building-code-compliant staircase. The board found the vertical extension of the non-conformity was necessary for the renovation of the two-family structure.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Tabled the approval of previous meeting minutes until the next session and recognized staff for administrative support.
